buildSourceNote: Build 131 carries v1.1.0-rc.7, found by driving one real gate-in -> gate-out on production (KA32AA5828 / JC-41368): the floor allocation modal no longer defaults to ids that do not exist ('B-01'/'TECH-001'); the allocated bay is now projected onto job_card_master.bay_id through bays.bay_code, so the technician no longer sees 'Bay: Not yet allocated' for a vehicle in a bay; the technician's Start button now calls /api/floor-execution/timer/start (it was a local setInterval that never reached the server, so no repair time was ever recorded); and technicians are identified by TECH-<employee_id>, which is what made /api/floor-execution/tech-work always return empty. See docs/CHANGELOG.md.
